finishedText:
Visit date: 12/11. 
Present: Maria Okonkwo-Reyes, Bea. 
During the visit, mould was seen in the back bedroom again, and it is worse by the window. The landlord has not replied to two emails. Maria Okonkwo-Reyes missed the benefits form deadline, a letter is present, and the date of birth on the form is 3/3/87. 
It was agreed that Bea will ring the landlord on Monday, and Maria Okonkwo-Reyes will post the form on Friday. Tomas Brandvold, who is a neighbour and also on Bea's list, offered to help with the form. 
The identified risks are rent arrears if the form is late. 
The next steps are to revisit on 26/11.
